hero.headline: Hi, I'm Monisha! A former architect turned Product Designer, making complex things feel simple.
hero.intro: I'm a NYC-based designer working at the intersection of product strategy, UX, and technology. With experience across enterprise SaaS, AI-powered tools, and consumer products, I turn complex workflows and data-rich systems into intuitive, human-centered experiences that drive measurable impact.

projects.name: Rokt
projects.title: Turn scattered churn signals into a shared retention workflow
projects.summary: I replaced fragmented reporting with automated signal capture, an account-manager review step, and a centralized dashboard—helping stakeholders prepare retention action plans faster.
projects.alt: Rokt competitive-intelligence demo with risk trends, account metrics, and review activity. All shown data is fictional.
projects.caption: Interactive demo · Fictional accounts and financial figures

home.title: Churn signals, in one place
home.summary: A shared workflow for spotting churn risk, reviewing signals, and planning a response.
home.caption: Demo · All data fictional

projects.name: Block Party
projects.title: Make neighborhood proposals easier to explore and shape
projects.summary: A simulation-based civic prototype lets younger Bloomington residents explore planning proposals and contribute ideas in context. Testing surfaced positive feedback and specific improvements to the proposal builder.
projects.outcomeLabel: tested the prototype and saw potential for inclusive participation
projects.alt: Block Party prototype showing a virtual Bloomington neighborhood and map navigation controls.
projects.caption: Capstone prototype · Qualitative feedback, not measured participation growth

home.title: A say in the neighborhood
home.summary: A civic-design prototype that helps Bloomington residents explore neighborhood proposals and share ideas.
home.caption: Capstone prototype

projects.name: iHeartMedia
projects.title: Make listening easier to start and more social
projects.summary: As a product designer and product manager, I contributed to a studio team exploring simpler onboarding and more social listening experiences.
projects.outcomeLabel: design concepts informed by usability findings
projects.alt: Shared iHeartMedia studio concepts showing the listening home, music player, and favorite-genre selection.
projects.caption: Shared studio project · Retention impact not established
projects.credit: Project visual: shared case study by Manasi Ghutukade

home.title: A more connected way to listen
home.summary: Simpler onboarding and social listening concepts, designed with a studio team.
home.caption: Studio project
